title: Before Apply, show who on today's board the floor move pulls into reach
deviations_from_card: Per the critic revision: floorPreviewView.ts/.test.ts and a separate route.test.ts dropped - diffFloorMove itself returns rows grouped per role, capped at 5 with more/total, each with a board href; route covered inside analytics-writes-authority.test.ts (viewer 403, ABSENT 409, junk family 400, previewed threshold == apply's live recommendation and floor unmoved, all three calibration routes derive via liveScreeningRecommendation); app/api/analytics/calibration/route.ts added and now reads calibration-recommendation.ts (handing in its already-read pairs, heldOut memo and rule, so no extra scan); the family preview passes the MERGED familyFloors map (pinned by a case where an unmerged override would show a data_ai entry leaving reach). Other deviations: (1) the board has no entry-id deep-link param, so each name links the house `/?tab=pipeline&q=<label>` search link (task-outcome-summary.ts / history page convention) instead of an entry id; (2) a fourth bucket `spared` (count) for people the new floor reaches but the calibration holdout or a reinstatement keeps - the critic's 'no slot for held-out' caveat; shielded = newly under the floor + inside the tie-safe bottom cut (recomputed with the wave's own screenBottomCount/tieSafeBottomCount) + earlyCareer/unknownArchetype keep; (3) the preview is on demand (a BTN_GHOST beside Apply), not auto-fetched on every card render - it costs two dry runs per role and is seat-gated; (4) fault code reuses SCREEN_WAVE_FAILED (the preview IS the wave's dry run) - no new error codes; (5) two source-guard tests outside the write set updated in the feat commit because they pinned the old inline derivation: calibration-holdout-arm.test.ts (now pins the clean-arm expressions in the helper and forbids an inline recommendScreeningThreshold( in all three routes) and db/pipeline-calibration.test.ts (advance-axis gate now `outcome === "advance" ? liveScreeningRecommendation(` + the helper reads both pair sets on the advance axis); (6) match-score.test.ts forbids `matchScore ?? 0` app-wide - the bucket sort uses `?? -1`.
notes: Dry-run discipline kept: floor-move-preview.ts only calls runScreenWave(..., {dryRun:true}, ws) and listPipeline/getDecisionConfig reads; the 'writes nothing' case snapshots board, events (1000), sealed records and the screening rule before/after. Shield decided by runScreenWave's readLiveArchetypes() (slot A) - no bundled-registry read in the preview. Workspace-scoped end to end; no SQL in the new modules. Counts + names only, no rates. Perf: measured on a git archive of the committed tree + my files alone: app/page.tsx +0 modules / +5 KB (9162 -> 9167) -> raised maxKb 9146 -> 9151 under the lock (301893e39); floor-preview route 116 modules / 1769 KB; calibration + apply-threshold routes +1 module / +2-3 KB each, under the group ceiling. test:perf still red on the shared checkout ONLY on foreign findings: app/page.tsx 1441/1434 modules and 9179 KB (the committed tree was already 1441/9162 before this card - the journeys cohort commit 1e52a019f - plus sibling uncommitted working files), and hire-from-need 3187/3186 KB (not in my graph). Full test:unit: the only failure is python-runner-concurrency.test.ts FLAKE (foreign, same as slot A saw). tsc: clean outside the untracked kpi-sim/ copy tree (foreign). Messages/api-reference were clean by the time I edited (the journey session had committed), so the lock commits carry only my hunks. Perf cost note: each preview re-hydrates the board via listPipeline(ws) twice per role (critic caveat) - bounded by the 30/10min limiter and on-demand fetch; loop_open: none of the refused/gated actions is new (the preview adds a read behind the Apply seat; the ThresholdSuggestion card is still offered to viewers, whose Apply and preview both answer ANALYTICS_POLICY_FORBIDDEN in their language - unchanged posture from before this card).
